comment:
* A memory-mapped file. Use {@link #mmapRO} to map a file, {@link #close} to unmap a file,
 * and either {@link #bigEndianIterator} or {@link #littleEndianIterator} to get a seekable
 * {@link BufferIterator} over the mapped data. This class is not thread safe.

methods.name: public static MemoryMappedFile mmapRO(String path) throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: * Use this to mmap the whole file read-only.

methods.name: public void close() throws ErrnoException
methods.comment: * Unmaps this memory-mapped file using munmap(2). This is a no-op if close has already been * called. Note that this class does not use finalization; you must call {@code close} * yourself. * * Calling this method invalidates any iterators over this {@code MemoryMappedFile}. It is an * error to use such an iterator after calling {@code close}.

methods.name: public BufferIterator bigEndianIterator()
methods.comment: * Returns a new iterator that treats the mapped data as big-endian.

methods.name: public BufferIterator littleEndianIterator()
methods.comment: * Returns a new iterator that treats the mapped data as little-endian.

methods.name: void checkNotClosed()
methods.comment: Throws {@link IllegalStateException} if the file is closed.

methods.name: public int size()
methods.comment: * Returns the size in bytes of the memory-mapped region.

methodNames: public static MemoryMappedFile mmapRO(String path) throws ErrnoException
